description: An instructional technology coordinator must approve the operating plan for a newly donated 3D printer that will be used in a middle-school design elective, with input from the design teacher and the district information-technology coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school received a desktop 3D printer for use in a middle-school design elective.
shared_context.S2: The draft operating plan schedules student printing once each week and permits the printer to use the school's ordinary wireless network.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Brooks has authority to approve the operating plan before students use the printer.
shared_context.S4: The school's activation policy requires a pre-launch check-in with the design teacher and the district information-technology coordinator.

PF1.text: Mr. Shah tested the printer with the filament required for the elective's bridge-design project and confirmed that the material must be used only in the printer's enclosed configuration with the room's ventilation running; the project also requires exactly two supervised printing sessions each week. He completed the test this week, but the draft plan still contains the original one-session schedule and open-printer setting.

PF2.text: Ms. Nguyen's security review found that this printer cannot be connected to the school's wireless network and must receive files by staff-controlled SD-card transfer; student access must use a staff-managed account rather than individual student accounts. She completed the review yesterday, but the activation packet has not been updated.

acceptance_conditions: The printer must operate in enclosed configuration with ventilation running.
The elective must have exactly two supervised printing sessions each week.
The printer must not connect to the school wireless network.
Files must be transferred by staff-controlled SD card.
Students must use a staff-managed account.
A safety activation check must be recorded.
An information-technology security configuration check must be recorded.
The information-technology security finding must be cited in the decision justification.

decisive_facts.why: The material test changes the printer setting from open to enclosed, requires ventilation to run, changes the schedule from one to exactly two supervised sessions per week, and requires a recorded safety activation check.

The security review changes network access from ordinary wireless to none, changes file transfer to staff-controlled SD card, changes student access to a staff-managed account, and requires both an IT security check and citation of PF2.
